events.title: Korean War Armistice Agreement Signed
events.description: Representatives of the United Nations Command, North Korea, and China signed the Korean Armistice Agreement at Panmunjom, ending open hostilities after three years of fighting. The agreement established the Korean Demilitarized Zone along roughly the 38th parallel.
events.significance: The armistice halted large-scale fighting but no formal peace treaty was ever signed, so the Korean peninsula remains technically at war and divided to this day.

events.title: Battle of Bouvines
events.description: King Philip II of France decisively defeated a coalition led by Holy Roman Emperor Otto IV, along with English and Flemish forces allied with King John of England, near Bouvines in Flanders.
events.significance: The victory strengthened the French monarchy, weakened King John's position in England and contributed to the baronial crisis that led to Magna Carta in 1215.

events.title: Completion of the First Successful Transatlantic Telegraph Cable
events.description: The SS Great Eastern completed laying a durable telegraph cable between Valentia Island, Ireland, and Newfoundland, establishing lasting telegraph communication between Europe and North America.
events.significance: It reduced communication times between continents from weeks to minutes, transforming global commerce, diplomacy and news.

events.title: Centennial Olympic Park Bombing
events.description: A pipe bomb exploded in Centennial Olympic Park in Atlanta during the 1996 Summer Olympics, killing one person and injuring over a hundred. The bomber, Eric Rudolph, was later captured and convicted.
events.significance: The attack prompted major changes in security planning for large international events and was a notable case of domestic terrorism in the United States.

events.title: Bugs Bunny Makes His Official Debut
events.description: The Warner Bros. cartoon A Wild Hare, directed by Tex Avery, premiered, introducing the fully formed character of Bugs Bunny and his catchphrase 'What's up, Doc?'
events.significance: Bugs Bunny became one of the most iconic animated characters in the world and a defining figure of American animation.
